subject: Re: dedal status - accept the ceiling, ship the recommendation
body:
Accept the ceiling. 0.81 vs 0.62 is a large enough win that shipping it windowed beats spending Q3 on a hierarchical scheme for the tail. Katya, put the boundary-crossing failure rate in the recommendation as a known limitation with a number attached - "about 70% of residual errors" - so whoever picks up the hierarchical work later starts from evidence.

One scope cut: we are not doing the third sequence type (config lineages) in this window. Q3 OKRs lock on 2026-06-26 and I would rather it appear there as a funded item than as an unstaffed bullet in our closeout.

Ivo - Wei's leaderboard has three teams submitting now, which is more adoption than I expected in six weeks. Please make sure it has an owner after this project closes; unowned shared infrastructure is how we end up rebuilding it next year.

Anders
